## Thesis Overview

I completed my undergraduate thesis 
entitled "The Failures of Moral Philosophy:
An Analysis of Ethics in Nazi Germany"
as part of the Political and Social
Thought program at the University
of Virginia.

The project represents the opportunity I had
to engage in independent, interdisciplinary
research and explore questions related
to moral philosophy.
